description.title: VLS
description.text: VLS or Valk Last Slot is a Last Slot Last Layer (LSLL) algorithm set, which both orients the last layer while inserting the last pair. The algorithm set is named after Mats Valk , who along with Rowe Hessler published and popularized the algorithem set. VLS is a superset of Winter Variation, named after Lucas Winter who published a set that solves OLL with a solved connected pair (F2L 1). Mats used VLS to break the (former) world record of 4.74sec
